TIM_NEVER_CONSIDER_RULES

OWNER=Tim Pruitt

STATUS=ACTIVE

PURPOSE=Canonical hard-exclusion configuration for job discovery intake. This file controls which employer/role domains Scout may exclude before creating a SCOUT_INTAKE or DISCOVERY_LEAD row.

SCOPE=Discovery admission only. This file is not a job database and does not replace the fixed canonical master.

DEFAULT_ACTION=ALLOW_INTAKE

UNKNOWN_RULE=Unknown or incomplete information is NOT a reason to exclude. Unknown remains a research state.

EXCEPTION_AUTHORITY=Tim explicit override only.

AUDIT_REQUIREMENT=Every hard exclusion must be counted and logged by RULE_ID in the Scout run metrics. Nothing may silently disappear.

GENERAL INTERPRETATION RULES

1. Apply hard exclusions based primarily on the employer's core operating business/domain, not incidental keywords in the job description.

2. Do NOT exclude an industrial supplier, automation company, equipment maker, software company, integrator, consulting firm, or engineering company merely because it serves an excluded industry.

3. Do NOT exclude a role merely because compensation, degree/FLEX, reporting level, exact req ID, plant ownership, work arrangement, scope, or other decision-quality data is unknown.

4. Do NOT exclude solely because a role is Manager or Senior Manager, comes from a recruiter/aggregator, lacks a first-party ATS URL, or requires more research.

5. When classification is genuinely ambiguous, DO NOT hard-exclude. Admit as SCOUT_INTAKE or DISCOVERY_LEAD and record the ambiguity.

6. Hard exclusions prevent initial master-row creation only when the rule clearly applies. Scout must still log the excluded discovery in run metrics with company/title/source and RULE_ID.

7. If a role already exists in the canonical master, these rules do not authorize deletion. Existing rows remain auditable; downstream disposition may use the applicable rule with Tim/Forge governance.

ACTIVE RULES

RULE_ID=NC-001

CATEGORY=PHARMACEUTICAL_MANUFACTURER

ACTION=DO_NOT_ADD

MATCH=Employer's primary business is pharmaceutical drug development, pharmaceutical manufacturing, or commercial pharmaceutical production.

DO_NOT_MATCH=Industrial suppliers, automation/equipment vendors, contract engineering firms, software vendors, or other companies merely serving pharmaceutical customers.

REASON=Tim does not want pharmaceutical-company roles.

EXCEPTION=Tim explicit override.

STATUS=ACTIVE

RULE_ID=NC-002

CATEGORY=MEDICAL_DEVICE_MANUFACTURER

ACTION=DO_NOT_ADD

MATCH=Employer's primary business is manufacturing or commercializing medical devices, medical equipment, surgical devices, diagnostic devices, or comparable regulated healthcare hardware.

DO_NOT_MATCH=Industrial suppliers, machine builders, automation/integration companies, component suppliers, software vendors, or other companies merely serving medical-device customers.

REASON=Tim does not want medical-device-company roles.

EXCEPTION=Tim explicit override.

STATUS=ACTIVE

RULE_ID=NC-003

CATEGORY=FOOD_OR_BEVERAGE_MANUFACTURER

ACTION=DO_NOT_ADD

MATCH=Employer's primary business is manufacturing, processing, packaging, or commercially producing food or beverage products.

DO_NOT_MATCH=Packaging-equipment makers, automation vendors, industrial equipment suppliers, refrigeration/process-equipment companies, logistics firms, or other companies merely serving food/beverage manufacturers.

REASON=Tim does not want food/beverage-manufacturing-company roles.

EXCEPTION=Tim explicit override.

STATUS=ACTIVE

RULE_ID=NC-004

CATEGORY=RESTAURANT_OR_FOOD_SERVICE

ACTION=DO_NOT_ADD

MATCH=Employer's primary business is restaurant operations, fast-food operations, quick-service restaurants, food service, catering, or similar consumer meal-service operations.

DO_NOT_MATCH=Industrial equipment suppliers, restaurant-equipment manufacturers, automation/software vendors, logistics firms, or other companies merely serving restaurants.

REASON=Tim does not want restaurant/fast-food/food-service roles.

EXCEPTION=Tim explicit override.

STATUS=ACTIVE

SCOUT REQUIRED OUTPUT FOR EXCLUSIONS

For every excluded discovery record:

SCOUT_RUN_ID=

DISCOVERED_AT_ET=

COMPANY=

TITLE=

LOCATION=

SOURCE=

SOURCE_URL=

NEVER_CONSIDER_RULE_ID=

EXCLUSION_CONFIDENCE=HIGH|MED|LOW

EXCLUSION_REASON=

TIM_OVERRIDE=NO

RUN-LEVEL COUNTERS

GROSS_FOUND=

NEVER_CONSIDER_EXCLUDED=

NC-001_COUNT=

NC-002_COUNT=

NC-003_COUNT=

NC-004_COUNT=

ENTERED_MASTER=

SCOUT_INTAKE_WRITTEN=

DISCOVERY_LEAD_WRITTEN=

EXISTING_MATCH=

WRITE_FAILED=

QUALITY PRINCIPLE

Scout quality must not improve artificially by hiding uncertain discoveries. A legitimate role later declined for Tim's pay, geography, FLEX, scope, or other preference remains a valid Scout discovery. NEVER_CONSIDER is only for Tim-owned hard exclusions.

CHANGE CONTROL

- Tim may add, disable, edit, or override rules.

- Grok/Scout, Claude, and Forge may propose changes but may not invent new hard exclusion categories.

- A new or modified hard exclusion rule becomes active only after Tim approval and update of this canonical file.

- Preserve rule IDs for historical metrics. If a rule is retired, set STATUS=INACTIVE rather than reusing its RULE_ID.

END TIM_NEVER_CONSIDER_RULES
